To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we determined the structures of Pol IIIB pre-initiation complexes and elongation complexes, which provide insights into how Pol III initiates transcription and re-initiates transcription.

we determined the structures of RNA polymerase (RNAP) III pre-initiation complex (PIC) in complex with the TFIIIB complex using single particle cryoelectron microscopy (cryoEM) and a 3D structure of RNAP III in complex with the elongation complex scaffold, providing insights into how TFIIIB and RNAP III interact with each other and into the mechanism of RNAP III recycling prior to re-initiation.

the structures of RNA polymerase (Pol) III transcription initiation complexes (PICs), determined by cryo-EM, reveal that TFIIIB tightly binds to the upstream promoter DNA and interacts with Pol III, and the structure of Pol III elongation complex (Pol III EC) reveals the mechanism of facilitated transcription re-initiation by Pol III.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the structural visualization of Pol III PIC and EC, and provides insights into the molecular mechanism of Pol III transcription initiation, elongation and re-initiation
the structural analysis of the transcription initiation process by Pol III.
the structural analysis of Pol III PICs in various functional states.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Pol III transcription machinery is a stable complex, with a unique structure and function.
our structures provide a molecular understanding of the Pol III PIC, which is the basis for the Pol III transcription machinery.
the structures provide a structural basis for understanding the mechanism of Pol III initiation and facilitated recycling.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the structural information we provide for the Pol III PIC and EC will be useful for the understanding of transcription initiation and re-initiation mechanisms.
we determined the structural architecture of the Pol III PIC and the mechanism of facilitated re-initiation of Pol III transcription.
the Pol III PIC is structurally similar to that of Pol II PIC, but the Pol III EC is structurally similar with that of Pol I EC.
The main takeaway from our work is that
TFIIIB is an essential factor for Pol III PIC formation and stabilization.

the structure of Pol III PIC is similar to the Pol II PIC, and that the Pol III EC is similar to the elongation complexes of both Pol I and Pol II, which is likely to reflect a conserved mechanism for facilitated recycling of the polymerases.
the structure and function of Pol III transcription machinery are distinct from those of Pol II and Pol I.
